question: On the exact current correlated K times Lambda strip, does the selected real plus-recessive projective kappa sensitivity h=partial_kappa rho remain uniformly strictly negative after finite transport from Qplus=4 to Qswitch=-29/10?
primary_sources: NIST DLMF section 2.7(iii), Liouville-Green approximation for the pinned selected real plus-recessive family: https://dlmf.nist.gov/2.7#iii

declared_conventions.selected_family: the same real plus-recessive direction and exact correlated strip pinned by the upstream anchor and sign-strip results
declared_conventions.exact_rho_barrier: -1<=rho<=1 from Qplus through Qswitch on the full declared strip
declared_conventions.analytic_sign_floor: p(Qswitch)>kappa_left/20 from the first delta_Q=1/10 window
declared_conventions.derivative_scope: two-sided partial_kappa derivative in the corridor interior and the corresponding one-sided derivative at each kappa face, at fixed lambda
declared_conventions.execution: exact SymPy identities plus python-flint Arb monotone positive-kernel panels; no Bessel evaluation, black-box ODE, quadrature, root solve, finite difference, sampling, compact Taylor transfer or bisection

upstream_results.role: pins the exact Qplus h interval and the two-parameter diagonal derivative construction
pins the exact current strip, selected-family linkage and independently certified rho in [-1,1] barrier through Qswitch; its face signs are not derivative evidence

method_sources.role: real Arb interval construction, intersection, containment and record primitives only; the kappa forcing comparison is implemented and audited locally

assumptions: The hash-pinned endpoint anchor supplies p(4)=-h(4)>0 on the entire exact strip without using a finite difference.
The hash-pinned sign strip supplies the same selected family and an independently certified rho in [-1,1] barrier on the whole Qplus-to-Qswitch leg.

The endpoint anchor supplies an existing pointwise kappa derivative seed. Standard smooth parameter dependence of the finite Riccati IVP on the certified finite rho tube propagates it; no singular-endpoint C1 condition is assumed.

Variation of constants and coefficient comparison are applied only to the scalar linear p equation with positive forcing. The panel ladder bounds its monotone lower comparison kernel, while the upper comparison forcing integral is elementary.
A strict Qswitch sign remains a projective endpoint fact. It does not transport h to Q0 or differentiate the complete declared boundary functional.
